digest.component_or_area: CLI reference generation and distribution validation
propositions: CLI reference syntax sections must be generated deterministically from registry enumeration and committed help bytes, proven byte-identical by --check across Python versions
Manual command census (INTERCEPT_COMMANDS, regex parsing, hand-curated route unions) must be eliminated; tests must enumerate routes from registry programmatically
A clean no-extras wheel must render all approved help forms with exact committed bytes and no side effects from operation/config/store/handler/heavy imports
Every lazy handler/parser/selector reference and capability-to-extra mapping must resolve without command execution in a full-extra contract test
Editorial prose (examples, rationale) must be structurally separate from generated syntax and linted to reject conflicting usage/option authorities
The same CLI validation commands must execute identically locally and in portable CI, with rebar-mcp smoke-tested as a separate entry point
